    line_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    line_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)

        # Locate non-background object cells robustly as colors other than stripe/background.
        colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != grid[line_row][0]]
        bg = max(set(colors), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        rs = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (grid[line_row][0], bg)]
        side = -1 if rs and min(rs) < line_row else 1
        mark = line_row + side
        if 0 <= mark < h: out[mark] = [8] * w
    elif line_col is not None:

        others=[v for row in grid for v in row if v != axiscolor]

        side=-1 if cs and min(cs)<axis else 1

        if 0<=mark<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
    return out
